## Dược dân tộc học

| <RowID>   | Vùng lãnh thổ   | Chứng và bệnh   |
|-----------|-----------------|-----------------|
| Row0      | Elsewhere       | Thuốc bổ        |

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/smiles-drawer@2.0.1/dist/smiles-drawer.min.js"></script>
<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    const molecules = [
        {id: "canvas_Row0", smiles: "COc1c(O)c(C)c(Cl)c(O)c1Cl" },
{id: "canvas_Row1", smiles: "COc1ccc(C=C2Oc3cc(O)cc(O)c3OC2=O)cc1" },
{id: "canvas_Row2", smiles: "Cc1cc(O)cc(O)c1Cl" },
{id: "canvas_Row3", smiles: "COc1ccc(/C=C2\Oc3cc(O)cc(O)c3OC2=O)cc1" },
{id: "canvas_Row4", smiles: "Cc1cc(O)c(Cl)c(O)c1" },
{id: "canvas_Row5", smiles: "Cc1cc(O)cc(O)c1" }
    ];
    const drawer = new SmilesDrawer.Drawer({ width: 150, height: 150 });
    molecules.forEach(mol => {
      SmilesDrawer.parse(mol.smiles, function (tree) {
        drawer.draw(tree, mol.id, "light", false);
      });
    });
  });
</script>
